raw.one_liner: Narma provides an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies to visualize, validate, and deploy AI automation at scale.
raw.thesis: Narma is building an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies. The core innovation lies in its three-layer system: observation through desktop sensors, an intelligence layer that detects employee intent and workflow drift, and an execution layer that automatically generates and deploys AI agents. This system aims to address the challenges AI-first companies face in scaling AI automation, specifically pinpointing where AI can deliver savings, ensuring reliable ROI measurement, and managing workflow drift. Narma seeks to provide a continuous AI lift by observing work, deciding AI actions, and auto-building agents. It uses existing foundation models, focusing its innovation on the "Work Graph" to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for AI intervention. The target user is AI-first companies that need to visualize, validate, and implement AI automation at scale. The venture seeks to provide a comprehensive solution that goes beyond basic task automation by understanding intent and adapting to evolving workflows. This venture functions as a complement to existing AI solutions by identifying and optimizing opportunities for AI deployment rather than replacing current AI models.
raw.product_description: Narma is a three-layered system designed to facilitate AI automation in enterprise environments. Layer 1, the "Observe" layer, uses lightweight desktop sensors to capture work patterns, application usage, activity sequences, and time allocation. Layer 2, the "Intelligence Layer" or "Brain," detects employee intent, assesses the business value of tasks, and identifies "drift" where work deviates from intended flows. Layer 3, the "Execution Layer" or "Agent Factory," automatically generates, deploys, and monitors AI agents for high-ROI opportunities, incorporating built-in approval gates. Narma leverages existing foundation models, concentrating its efforts on creating a "Work Graph" to reveal resource allocation and identify strategic points for AI intervention.
raw.what_makes_this_different: Narma's core innovation is its multi-layered "Enterprise Agentic Brain" that observes work patterns, detects employee intent and workflow drift, and then automates the generation and deployment of AI agents for high-ROI opportunities. This approach focuses on optimizing existing AI models by understanding the "Work Graph" of an organization.
